summary: PROD chat E2E completed against https://auremcto.com using founder credentials teji.ss1986@gmail.com/Singh1986$. Tested both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). Used the EXISTING connected project 'automation' → TJSNDHU/Aurem (status=connected, 56 tasks_done) instead of creating a new one — the founder already has 1 project (not 0 as task assumed; /projects/list path used in task is 404 — actual endpoint is /api/aurem-dev/cto/projects/list which returns the 'automation' project pointing at TJSNDHU/Aurem). No code modifications were made. All SSE chat streams returned HTTP 200 with text/event-stream. /auth/me, login, /cto/projects/list, /chat/sessions all clean. Found 2 functional issues: (1) CASUAL-tier replies render with an EMPTY assistant bubble (no text streamed back) on both desktop and mobile, (2) AGENTIC tier request 'list the top-level files of this repository' hung in 'thinking · 8.0s' state for >60s without producing a repo file listing during the test window. Found 1 instrumentation gap: PersistentFixBar component is NOT discoverable via any reasonable selector (no data-testid, no class match) on either viewport — either it isn't mounted on /dashboard or it lacks discoverable hooks, blocking the 'fix bar must not overlap composer' verification.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'Not Found' — referenced in task spec and likely in older docs. Actual working path is /api/aurem-dev/cto/projects/list. Recommend adding an alias or updating callers/docs.

ui_bugs.issue: Sending a casual message ('hi there testing 212m154' desktop, 'hi from mobile test' mobile) creates the user bubble and shows the CASUAL tier pill, but the assistant reply bubble renders empty (just a black pill with no text) even after waiting 30s and after a full page reload. The empty bubble persists across reload (so the missing content is server-side, not just a transient render). Network: /chat/stream returns 200 text/event-stream — so the stream opens but appears to emit no text frame, OR the FE drops the frame. Compare with QUERY tier in same session which renders a full answer in <10s.
ui_bugs.selector: assistant bubble after user 'hi' message in ChatPanel

ui_bugs.issue: 'list the top-level files of this repository' classified correctly (visible thinking pill) but stayed in 'thinking · 8.0s' state for the full 60s wait window with no tool-call output or file listing rendered. The repo IS connected (TJSNDHU/Aurem, has_pat=true). Either the agentic tool call is very slow, hanging, or not wired up for the read-only listing path. No 4xx/5xx surfaced.

Component not discoverable in DOM on /dashboard at either 1440x900 or 390x844 via any of: [data-testid*='persistent'|'fix-bar'], [class*='PersistentFix'|'FixBar'|'fix-bar']. Either not mounted, or it lacks the data-testid the task description references. This blocks E2E verification of 'fix bar must not overlap composer'.

integration_issues.issue: SSE stream HTTP 200 text/event-stream opens but no visible assistant text rendered. Possibly the casual tier emits an empty/zero-length completion or only a system ack that ChatPanel filters out.

Top header tabs (Swift/Pro/Maxx, Chat/Preview/Graph) appear cramped and the '10 ships this week — tap to share' floating banner partially overlaps the 'New run' button in the top-right at 390px width.

rca_of_the_issue.casual_empty_bubble: Reproduction: Login as founder on PROD → /dashboard (project TJSNDHU/Aurem auto-loaded) → type 'hi there testing 212m154' → Enter. Expected: assistant bubble with greeting. Actual: bubble renders empty, persists across full page reload. SSE call returns 200 text/event-stream and there are no 4xx/5xx anywhere. Hypothesis: casual tier in intent_gateway short-circuits without emitting a content delta, OR the FE's SSE consumer in ChatPanel doesn't render the casual ack frame shape. Mitigation: in /chat/stream casual branch, always emit at least one `data: {"delta":"..."}` frame before `[DONE]`.
rca_of_the_issue.agentic_hang: Reproduction: Same project, send 'list the top-level files of this repository'. Expected: tool call → list of repo files within ~20s. Actual: thinking pill stuck at '8.0s' through full 60s wait window. Mitigation: add execution timeout + user-facing 'tool timeout' message in loop_engine.execute, and verify GitHub tool calls actually fire (capture logs for read_repo_file invocations on this user_id).
